description: Day-trip activities with official sources. Drive or transit times are shown only when an official source states them. Blank = unverified.

activities.name: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area
activities.hours: Scenic Drive Nov-Feb 6 a.m.-5 p.m. Visitor Center daily 8 a.m.-4:30 p.m. (S16)
activities.tickets_reservations: Timed entry reservation required for the Scenic Drive and Visitor Center Oct 1 - May 31 (entry 8 a.m.-5 p.m.) at recreation.gov or (877) 444-6777 (S16). Entry fee amount not captured.
activities.public_transit: Public transportation does not extend to Red Rock (S15). Outside the 1-hour bus/subway test.
activities.exceptions: Thanksgiving and Christmas Day: Scenic Drive 6 a.m.-12 p.m. (S16)
activities.open_feb_15_18_2027: Mon 15 - Thu 18: Scenic Drive 6 a.m.-5 p.m.; timed entry required (Feb is in the Oct-May window)

activities.name: Valley of Fire State Park
activities.hours: Open daily sunrise to sunset. Visitor Center daily 9 a.m.-4 p.m. (S17)
activities.tickets_reservations: $10 per Nevada vehicle, $15 non-Nevada vehicle (S17). Day use does not require reservation (S17).
activities.public_transit: No public transit stated. Park warns that rideshare can strand visitors (S17).
activities.exceptions: Annual maintenance closure Dec 1-14 (S17). Many trails are closed May 15 - Sep 30 (S17).
activities.open_feb_15_18_2027: Mon 15 - Thu 18: sunrise to sunset (Visitor Center 9 a.m.-4 p.m.)

activities.name: Lake Mead National Recreation Area
activities.tickets_reservations: Standard entrance pass $15-$25. Private vehicle $25 for 1-7 days. Cashless (card only). Annual pass $45 (S18).
activities.exceptions: Lake use fees apply in addition to entrance pass (S18).

activities.name: Hoover Dam (Bureau of Reclamation)
activities.tickets_reservations: Official page shows 'Hoover Dam Tour Tickets - not currently available' at time of fetch (S20). Tour details page not captured.
activities.exceptions: Special event activities may be restricted in the weeks around Easter, the first 2 weeks of August, 3 days after Thanksgiving, and the week after Christmas through the first Monday of January (S20).
